items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Pete said, Billy, you ain't talking about that. I said, uh-huh, yeah, I fool you. Obviously have a good time. Musicians, them days wasn't like this now. Musicians used to love each other... Pete was like that. Sometimes we'd meet Fest, Banana. Sometimes, Charlotte Love and all of them, we'd meet the

ctx.x: Did Vic use that loose wrist

like you had? That's just where Vic taught me. Is that where you learned the same way? Talked me that same way. So they had plenty of around here and the same old Jim Crow. He said, man, you sure learned how to play the trumpet on that horn quick. I used to play the drummer with Jim Crow and all that. You know, I sure played quick. I said, I learned the music, that's all. I learned the horn. I get on my bells and everything and play. I was out Tranchino one night there and Tranchino bought a big Xelophon and…
Now, where did you learn to play drums? Who was your teacher on drums?
